description: Angular component for a device creation wizard dialog in the Thingsboard UI, managing form inputs, stepper navigation, and device creation logic.

classes.name: DeviceWizardDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for device wizard dialog, handling form steps, device creation, and UI interactions.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without returning a device.

methods.name: previousStep
methods.description: Navigate to the previous step in the wizard.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Navigate to the next step in the wizard.

methods.name: getFormLabel
methods.description: Returns label for form step based on index.

methods.name: get maxStepperIndex
methods.description: Returns the maximum index of the stepper steps.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a device if form is valid and closes dialog with the created device.

methods.name: deviceProfileChanged
methods.description: Updates transport type and credentials step requirement based on selected device profile.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Constructs device object and calls device service to save it, handling credentials and errors.

methods.name: allValid
methods.description: Checks if all steps in the wizard are valid.

methods.name: changeStep
methods.description: Handles step change event, updating UI state.
